chat_controls.model_none: No models yet. An admin adds a provider in Settings, Models.
chat_controls.model_default_hint: The agent's own default for this profile.
chat_controls.approval_admin: Only an admin changes the approval mode.
chat_controls.approval_applies: Applies to every chat with this agent in this profile.

approval_hint.ask: Asks before a command or a write outside the working folder.
approval_hint.always: Asks before everything, reads included. Slowest, safest.
approval_hint.auto_safe: Runs what it judges safe, asks about the rest.
approval_hint.off: No gate at all: commands, files and network without permission.
approval_hint.smart: A helper model lets the safe ones through and asks about the rest.

chat_controls.folder_hint: Where this chat works on disk. It is fixed once the chat has run.
chat_controls.folder_automatic_note: The hub names it after the chat.
chat_controls.folder_bad_name: A folder name, not a path.
chat_controls.delete_body: Its messages go with it, and there is no undo.
chat_controls.compress_wait: Wait for the running reply to finish, then compress.
chat_controls.compress_skipped: A compression of this chat is already running.
chat_controls.steer_hint: Guide the running reply without stopping it.
chat_controls.steer_queued: The reply could not take it now; it goes as the next message.
